# instudia

> Nagaland's career-first computer and technical skill development institute based in Dimapur, Nagaland, India. ISO 9001:2015 certified.

## Core Information
- **Institution Name**: instudia
- **Website**: https://www.instudianagaland.com
- **Accreditation**: ISO 9001:2015 Certified Skill Development Institute
- **Headquarters / Campus**: First Floor, Vikiye Center, Opposite Notun Bosti Gate, Fellowship Colony, Dimapur, Nagaland 797112, India
- **Coordinates**: 25.9123 N, 93.7251 E
- **Contact Phone**: +91 87985 87779
- **Contact Email**: instudia.nagaland@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM IST

## Academic Offerings & Professional Programs
instudia provides 19+ practical, project-based courses structured across four career departments:

### 1. Software Engineering & Programming
- **Programming with Python** (`/courses/python`): Fundamentals, data structures, automation scripts, and algorithmic thinking. Duration: 1-3 months.
- **Fullstack Web Development** (`/courses/fullstack-web-development`): Modern frontend and backend engineering with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Git. Duration: 3-6 months.
- **Frontend Development** (`/courses/frontend-development`): HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript ES6+, and React.
- **Backend Development** (`/courses/backend-development`): REST APIs, databases, authentication, server deployment.
- **C & C++ Programming** (`/courses/c-and-c-plus-plus`): Low-level systems programming, memory management, data structures.
- **Java Programming** (`/courses/java`): Object-oriented programming, enterprise application foundations.

### 2. Creative & Interface Design
- **Graphic Designing** (`/courses/graphic-designing`): Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, CorelDRAW, typography, visual branding, print media. Duration: 3-6 months.
- **UI/UX Designing** (`/courses/ui-ux-designing`): Figma, wireframing, interactive prototyping, user journey mapping, design systems. Duration: 3 months.
- **Video Editing** (`/courses/video-editing`): Premiere Pro, video pacing, color correction, audio mixing.
- **2D Animation** (`/courses/2d-animation`): Storyboarding, motion graphics, character animation.

### 3. Accounting, Finance & Business
- **Tally Prime with Accounting** (`/courses/tally`): Ledger management, voucher entry, inventory, bank reconciliation.
- **GST Compliance & Certification** (`/courses/gst`): GSTR-1, GSTR-3B return filing, e-way bills, input tax credits.
- **Advance Excel** (`/courses/advance-excel`): Formulas, pivot tables, lookup functions, dashboards, data analysis.
- **Business Intelligence using Power BI** (`/courses/buisness-intelligence-using-powerbi`): Data modeling, DAX queries, executive reports.

### 4. Foundational Computing & Office Tech
- **Diploma in Computer Applications (DCA)** (`/courses/diploma-in-computer-applications`): 6-month comprehensive foundational diploma covering MS Office suite, internet, typing, and office automation.
- **Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Applications (PGDCA)** (`/courses/pgdca`): 12-month advanced diploma for graduates covering database management, programming fundamentals, and office IT systems.
- **Certificate in Computer Applications (CCA)** (`/courses/cca`): Short-term 3-month foundational course.

## Free Student Success Suite
instudia provides free, browser-based career tools for students and job seekers across Northeast India:
- **Career Blueprint** (`/tools/career-blueprint`): AI career roadmap generator matching student interests to high-growth tech roles.
- **ATS Resume Analyzer** (`/tools/ats-analyzer`): Automated resume scan against technical job descriptions.
- **AI Resume Builder** (`/tools/resume-builder`): Clean, ATS-friendly markdown resume creator.
- **Nagaland Tech Salary Insights** (`/tools/salary-insights`): Regional market salary benchmarks.
- **Interactive Study Planner** (`/tools/study-planner`): Daily and weekly study schedule generator.
